verdict.rationale: Beamer documents collecting and prioritizing feedback, and it offers public and private roadmaps. Nothing in the evidence shows a feedback submission being converted directly into a task, roadmap item, or project intention. Prioritizing feedback and having a separate roadmap are adjacent features, not the conversion capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can turn a customer feedback submission directly into an actionable task or project intention
